# Fixture for PERF-PY-27 (safe): one read_bytes per distinct call argument
lang: python
file: app/structure_tree_check.py
---
from pathlib import Path

def analyze_pdf(pdf_path: str):
    data = Path(pdf_path).read_bytes()
    return len(data)

def main(pdfs):
    reports = []
    for pdf in pdfs:
        reports.append(analyze_pdf(pdf))
    return reports
